ranking._bullseyeComment: Some sources return only a snippet, so a posting whose title names one of her exact roles cannot earn skill points it deserves. Such a title floors the match here, provided nothing in the posting counts against it. Raise bullseyeTitleWeight to make the floor apply to fewer title groups.
ranking._unnamedEmployerComment: Reposting sites list themselves as the employer, so you cannot tell who is actually hiring. Those postings still appear, but sort lower by this fraction. Set to 0 to treat them like any other listing.
